Summary:

The Sr. Data & Reporting Analyst is responsible for all points of data mining, extraction, manipulation, analysis, and reporting. Accountable for developing and reporting daily, weekly and monthly analysis of key performance indicators related to warehouse operational metrics. This position requires an extremely detailed, timely, consistent and accurate approach to reporting. within our US Central Contamination Assessment & Remediation (CAR) South Business Group based in Golden, CO,

People leadership and team development: Provide direct line-management leadership for assigned team members, promote GHD’s core values, model collaboration, and create an employee experience where staff feel heard, supported, and engaged in their professional development.
Business group execution: Assist the Business Group Leader with implementation of the business plan, including workload planning, resourcing, systems, processes, risk management, and timely delivery of services that meet scope, quality, budget, safety, and client expectations.
